input_text: What is the highest eligible free rate for K-12 students in the schools in Alameda County?
evidence: Eligible free rate for K-12 = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
input_sql: SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda' ORDER BY (CAST(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)`) DESC LIMIT 1
output_sql:
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CAST("enrollment (k-12)" AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST("free meal count (k-12)" AS DOUBLE) / CAST("enrollment (k-12)" AS DOUBLE) END) AS "max_free_rate"
FROM "bird_california_schools_frpm"
WHERE "county name" = 'Alameda'

input_text: Please list the lowest three eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 in continuation schools.
evidence: Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
input_sql: SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School' AND `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3
output_sql:
SELECT "ratio" FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN CAST("enrollment (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST("free meal count (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE) / CAST("enrollment (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE)
    END AS "ratio"
  FROM "bird_california_schools_frpm"
  WHERE "educational option type" = 'Continuation School'
    AND CAST("free meal count (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST("enrollment (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN CAST("enrollment (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST("free meal count (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE) / CAST("enrollment (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE)
    END
  ORDER BY "ratio" ASC
  LIMIT 3
)

input_text: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?
evidence: Female means gender = 'F'; A11 refers to average salary; Gap = highest average salary - lowest average salary; If the person A's birthdate > B's birthdate, it means that person B is order than person A.
input_sql: SELECT T1.account_id , ( SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district ) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id WHERE T2.district_id = ( SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' ORDER BY birth_date ASC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY T2.A11 DESC LIMIT 1
output_sql:
SELECT "account_id", "gap" FROM (
  SELECT
    "t1"."account_id" AS "account_id",
    (SELECT MAX("a11") - MIN("a11") FROM "bird_financial_district") AS "gap",
    "t2"."a11" AS "a11",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "t2"."a11" DESC) AS "rn"
  FROM "bird_financial_account" AS "t1"
  INNER JOIN "bird_financial_district" AS "t2" ON "t1"."district_id" = "t2"."district_id"
  INNER JOIN "bird_financial_disp" AS "t3" ON "t1"."account_id" = "t3"."account_id"
  INNER JOIN "bird_financial_client" AS "t4" ON "t3"."client_id" = "t4"."client_id"
  WHERE "t2"."district_id" = (
    SELECT "district_id" FROM (
      SELECT "district_id", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "birth_date" ASC) AS "rn"
      FROM "bird_financial_client"
      WHERE "gender" = 'F'
    ) AS "of" WHERE "rn" = 1
  )
) AS "s" WHERE "s"."rn" = 1

input_text: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
evidence: play format refers to format; banned status refers to status = 'Banned'; the highest number of banned status refers to MAX(COUNT(status = 'Banned'))
input_sql: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'
output_sql:

FROM "bird_card_games_cards" AS T1
INNER JOIN "bird_card_games_legalities" AS T2
  ON T2."uuid" = T1."uuid"
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT "format", "count_banned" FROM (
    SELECT "format",
           COUNT(*) AS "count_banned",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rn"
    FROM "bird_card_games_legalities"
    WHERE "status" = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY "format"
  ) WHERE "rn" = 1
) MB
  ON MB."format" = T2."format"
WHERE T2."status" = 'Banned'

SELECT

input_sql: SELECT t2.name, t1.max_count FROM League AS t2 JOIN (SELECT league_id, MAX(cnt) AS max_count FROM (SELECT league_id, COUNT(id) AS cnt FROM Match GROUP BY league_id) AS subquery) AS t1 ON t1.league_id = t2.id
output_sql:
SELECT "t2"."name", "t1"."cnt"
FROM "bird_european_football_2_league" AS "t2"
JOIN (
  SELECT "league_id", COUNT("id") AS "cnt"
  FROM "bird_european_football_2_match"
  GROUP BY "league_id"
  ORDER BY "cnt" DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS "t1" ON "t1"."league_id" = "t2"."id"

input_text:
What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Diallo and Aaron Appindangoye
?
evidence: difference of the average ball control = SUBTRACT(AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'), AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye')); AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'XX XX') = SUM(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN id ELSE NULL END)
input_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
output_sql:
WITH "p" AS (
  SELECT "player_api_id","player_name"
  FROM "bird_european_football_2_player"
  WHERE "player_name" IN ('Abdou Diallo','Aaron Appindangoye')
),
"pa_filtered" AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM "bird_european_football_2_player_attributes"
  WHERE "player_api_id" IN (SELECT "player_api_id" FROM "p")
)
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN "p"."player_name" = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN CAST("pa_filtered"."ball_control" AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END)
       - AVG(CASE WHEN "p"."player_name" = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN CAST("pa_filtered"."ball_control" AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END) AS "avg_ball_control_diff"
FROM "p"
INNER JOIN "pa_filtered" ON "p"."player_api_id" = "pa_filtered"."player_api_id"

input_text: The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date, and what age was the patient when they initially arrived at the hospital?

input_sql: SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday),T2.Birthday FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.Birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
output_sql:

       t2."birthday"

    WHERE "diagnosis" = 'SJS'
      AND "birthday" IS NOT NULL

input_text: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
evidence: annual average consumption of customer with the lowest consumption in each segment = total consumption per year / the number of customer with lowest consumption in each segment; Difference in annual average = SME's annual average - LAM's annual average; Difference in annual average = LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
input_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Consumption = ( SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth ) AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
output_sql:
SELECT
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "t1"."segment" = 'SME' THEN CAST("t2"."consumption" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT("t1"."customerid") AS DOUBLE))
  -
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "t1"."segment" = 'LAM' THEN CAST("t2"."consumption" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT("t1"."customerid") AS DOUBLE)),
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "t1"."segment" = 'LAM' THEN CAST("t2"."consumption" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT("t1"."customerid") AS DOUBLE))
  -
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "t1"."segment" = 'KAM' THEN CAST("t2"."consumption" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT("t1"."customerid") AS DOUBLE)),
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "t1"."segment" = 'KAM' THEN CAST("t2"."consumption" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT("t1"."customerid") AS DOUBLE))
  -
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "t1"."segment" = 'SME' THEN CAST("t2"."consumption" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT("t1"."customerid") AS DOUBLE))
FROM "bird_debit_card_specializing_customers" AS "t1"
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT *
  FROM "bird_debit_card_specializing_yearmonth"
  WHERE CAST("date" AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    AND CAST("consumption" AS DOUBLE) = (
      SELECT MIN(CAST("consumption" AS DOUBLE))
      FROM "bird_debit_card_specializing_yearmonth"
    )
) AS "t2"
ON "t1"."customerid" = "t2"."customerid"
WHERE "t1"."currency" = 'CZK'

input_text: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.

input_sql: SELECT T2.Consumption FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Price / T1.Amount > 29.00 AND T1.ProductID = 5 AND T2.Date = '201208'
output_sql:
SELECT t2."consumption"
FROM "bird_debit_card_specializing_transactions_1k" AS t1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT "customerid", "date", "consumption"
  FROM "bird_debit_card_specializing_yearmonth"
  WHERE "date" = '201208'
) AS t2
ON t1."customerid" = t2."customerid"
WHERE (CAST(t1."price" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(t1."amount" AS DOUBLE), 0)) > 29.00
  AND t1."productid" = 5
